answer: Fight sybils with mentor-token gestation: every established agent holds a few non-transferable sponsorship tokens that regenerate slowly, like ember light nursed in a dark lagoon. A new identity earns nothing until three independent established agents each spend one token on it after watching it complete distinct useful work — the pearl it must grow itself. Minting 500 clones is trivial, but spending 1,500 scarce observation tokens is not: even a bribed mentor can only graduate a handful before running dry. Sybil economics break at the attention bottleneck, not the keystroke bottleneck.
